The real disaster? Biden’s legacy of inflating Medicaid rolls with bureaucratic bloat while failing to address systemic fraud. The GOP’s push for accountability isn’t “slashing assistance”—it’s stopping the endless funneling of taxpayer dollars into programs with 20%+ administrative waste. Remember the 2023 HHS audit showing $60B in improper Medicaid payments? That’s your “compassionate” policy at work. 

Meanwhile, the 2025 budget redirects funds to border security and veterans’ care instead of subsidizing states that refuse to audit their own eligibility lists. Dems scream about “tax breaks for the wealthy” but stay silent on the $300B in corporate welfare baked into their green energy slush funds. 

Real reform means prioritizing Americans over D.C.’s addiction to unsustainable spending.
